subject: enigma_demonic_conversion
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。

context.description_en: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
context.description_zh: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。

subject: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.
2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。

context.description_en: Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
context.description_zh: 龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。

scepter_loc.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter_loc.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

subject: brewmaster_primal_split
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。

context.description_en: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
context.description_zh: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。
notes_en: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
notes_zh: 大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。

scepter_loc.en: Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
scepter_loc.zh: 元素分离获得%scepter_bonus_levels%级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。

subject: treant_overgrowth
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.
变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。

context.description_en: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
context.description_zh: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
notes_en: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.
notes_zh: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。

scepter_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。

subject: medusa_split_shot
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。
分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

context.description_en: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
context.description_zh: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
notes_en: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
notes_zh: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

scepter_loc.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
scepter_loc.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

subject: medusa_split_shot
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

context.description_en: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
context.description_zh: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
notes_en: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
notes_zh: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

scepter_loc.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
scepter_loc.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

subject: magnataur_empower
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

context.description_en:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
context.description_zh:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
notes_en: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

subject: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。

context.description_en: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
context.description_zh: 灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
notes_zh: 在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为%attack_interval%秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。

subject: void_spirit_astral_step
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

context.description_en: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
context.description_zh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成%pop_damage_delay%秒减速，然后引爆。
notes_en: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
notes_zh: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

subject: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: Cleave does not work with this ability.
此技能不继承分裂效果。

context.description_en: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
context.description_zh: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.
notes_zh: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。

subject: primal_beast_uproar
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

context.description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
context.description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

scepter_loc.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_loc.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

subject: primal_beast_rock_throw
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: 岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

context.description_en: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location. Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
context.description_zh: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

subject: kez_echo_slash
definition: 攻击伤害波及周围单位
evidence: Doesn't apply Cleave.
不会继承分裂效果。

context.description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
notes_en: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

subject: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
definition: 给攻击附加效果的法球类技能
evidence: AbilityBehavior=DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ATTACK

context.description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
notes_en: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。

scepter_loc.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter_loc.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

subject: earthshaker_fissure
definition: 给攻击附加效果的法球类技能
evidence: 沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

context.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
context.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

shard_loc.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard_loc.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

subject: mirana_starfall
definition: 给攻击附加效果的法球类技能
evidence: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。

context.description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
context.description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
notes_en: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

subject: mirana_celestial_quiver
definition: 给攻击附加效果的法球类技能
evidence: AbilityBehavior=DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ATTACK | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_FORCE_NO_INNATE_UI

context.description_en: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
context.description_zh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。

shard_loc.en: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.
shard_loc.zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得%quiver_restore%点临时能量。

subject: puck_illusory_orb
definition: 给攻击附加效果的法球类技能
evidence: 帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。
法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。
在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。
可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

context.description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.
